name: Qingdao Haier Biomedical Co.,Ltd
summary: Qingdao Haier Biomedical Co.,Ltd engages in the research and development, manufacture, marketing, and sale of low temperature storage equipment for biomedical samples in China and internationally. The company offers ULT freezers, pharmacy refrigerators, freezers, automatic storage solutions, cryogenics, active temperature controlled RKN containers, and RTMD products; and CO2 incubation, standard incubators, biological safety cabinets, clean benches and laminar, and sterilization products.
